targetTasks.summary: Read AlembicCore/AGENTS.md, parent AGENTS.md, active index/status, state root, design §12.2 P5, §11.I, and the P2 freeze register. P5 scope is additive alias only: in AlembicCore barrels add ProjectIndex vocabulary aliases without changing existing implementations or call sites. Required aliases include buildProjectIndexFullPlan = buildColdStartWorkflowPlan, buildProjectIndexIncrementalPlan = buildKnowledgeRescanWorkflowPlan, createProjectIndexIntent* aliases for existing cold-start/knowledge-rescan intent creators, and buildProjectIndexGapPlan = buildKnowledgeRescanPlan. Keep every old export name and all frozen literals/paths stable, especially @alembic/core/plans, plan-selection symbols, response.tool/job kind/source/lifecycle strings, cleanup.projectRoot ternary, cold-start coverage behavior, package versions, release assets, BiliDili, and thread ids. No cross-host orchestrator unification, no call-site migration, no project-index folder collapse in P5. Because this is a Core-touch phase, after Core commit/build re-pin Alembic/vendor/AlembicCore and AlembicPlugin/vendor/AlembicCore to the new Core commit in the same logical phase and run consumer build:check. Required validation/evidence: grep/import proof that both old names and new ProjectIndex* aliases resolve from intended public barrels; Core npm run build:check, npm run test or justified focused tests plus build, npm run build, git diff --check; Alembic and AlembicPlugin vendor gitlink hashes re-pinned to the new Core commit; Alembic npm run build:check; AlembicPlugin npm run build:check. Commit locally on main in Core and in each consumer repo if vendor pins change; do not push. Return TargetResultEnvelope with Core and consumer commit hashes, changed files, validation summaries, old/new alias resolution proof, vendor pin evidence, and risks. No REAL-TEST required for P5 because the aliases are additive and behavior-neutral.
